name: Yōrō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yōrō town emblem in blue: a stylised angular device of stacked diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yōrō, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1955.

features.role: Yōrō town emblem — a stylised angular device of stacked diagonal strokes
